baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2, جَرَمَ, stands before three coordinated assertions.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cutting branch makes the opener close off alternatives, so the denial of the rival call, the return to God, and the fire classification read as one settled verdict rather than three loose claims.

activation_trace.role: Literal severance supplies the opener with the functional force of cutting off rival possibilities.

changed_reading.before: A conventional certainty marker introduces three propositions.
changed_reading.after: A verbal cutoff closes the rival case and presents the three propositions as a single verdict.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated د ع و forms at words 4 and 8 are separated by the negation at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: People can incline the speaker toward an entity by speech, but being called toward does not give that entity a voice, summons, or claim of its own. The construction denies possessed standing across both temporal domains.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies both the human recruitment and the denied capacity to issue an effective call.
The claim-and-affiliation sense makes the denied دعوة a lack of valid standing, not merely lack of sound.
Present-state negation blocks attribution of any such call or claim to the proposed object.

changed_reading.before: The false object is simply something that should not be invoked.
changed_reading.after: The verse distinguishes received recruitment from possessed standing: people call toward it, yet it owns no effective voice, summons, or claim anywhere.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 10 and 13 span the near and later domains, while words 15-17 route our return to God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two-domain denial removes every temporal venue for the rival claim, and the return construction directs all trajectories to the sole named object of worship. Ultimate destination therefore also functions as ultimate jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: The near or present domain supplies the first venue in which the rival has no standing.
The later or other domain supplies the second venue and closes temporal escape.
Return to a prior owner or place routes every person back toward one terminus.
The worship-object branch identifies God as the terminus that displaces rival objects.

changed_reading.before: Everyone eventually dies and goes back to God.
changed_reading.after: Every trajectory and claim is routed back to God, so the rival lacks both present and ultimate jurisdiction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 19, 21, and 22 join boundary-crossers, companionship, and fire.
baseline_models.mechanism: Crossing proper limits is not followed by a merely external penalty. The social noun of companionship makes the result an acquired, continuing association with the fire itself.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding a boundary supplies the conduct that generates the final association.
Literal accompaniment turns punishment into sustained proximity and belonging.
The kindled fire is the concrete associate to which the boundary-crossers become attached.

changed_reading.before: Generic sinners are punished in fire.
changed_reading.after: Those who overrun proper limits convert that excess into an abiding association: fire becomes their companion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first stages an attempt to make truth lose its footing, then declares the fire classification due, and later describes a decisive judgment in truth. Against that sequence, the focus opener marks the point where contest gives way to an enforceable conclusion.

activation_trace.role: Severance anchors the focus as the point that closes the contested case.
An argument made to fall supplies the attempted destabilization that the focus verdict answers.
A fixed, due obligation makes the earlier fire classification already binding.
Decisive judgment supplies the surah's final procedural analogue for the focus cutoff.

structural_cues: 40:5 places attempted argumentative displacement before 40:6's already-due fire classification; 40:78 later couples the arriving command with judgment in truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted dislodgement, a word becoming due, and final decisive judgment; I infer that their sequence gives the focus opener procedural closure. A live alternative is that the opener remains only a conventional emphatic idiom.

changed_reading.before: The speaker says that his next claims are certainly true.
changed_reading.after: The speaker closes an adversarial proceeding: rival argument has run out, and the resulting denial, return, and liability now stand as verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated contexts distinguish being invoked from being able to judge, answer, or secure relief. The focus denial therefore tests a whole reciprocal circuit: a valid دعوة has standing because an answering and adjudicating relation exists, whereas the proposed object is only the passive endpoint of human recruitment.

activation_trace.role: Claim and affiliation anchor the question of whether the proposed object possesses valid standing.
Negation denies that standing rather than denying that humans happen to address the object.
Invoked substitutes show that receiving human calls alone does not establish effective capacity.
The paired decisive-judgment forms contrast God's action with the invoked substitutes' inability to decide anything.
Repeated appeal inside loss demonstrates a call that has sound and intention but no effective route.
Direct address to God supplies the positive side of the call relation.
Answering speech completes the reciprocal circuit that the focus denies to the rival.

structural_cues: 40:20 contrasts God's judgment with the nonjudgment of invoked substitutes; 40:49-50 stages a failed delegated appeal; 40:60 places direct call beside answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies invocation without judgment, appeal without relief, and direct call followed by answer; I infer that reciprocity and standing define the contrast. A live alternative is that دعوة in the focus means only a valid claim or only an accepted invocation, not the full circuit.

changed_reading.before: The rival cannot hear prayer or should not be invoked.
changed_reading.after: The rival can be named and recruited toward, but it has no reciprocal response, adjudicative standing, or valid claim in either domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sentence after the focus transfers the speaker's affair to God, and the next sentence narrates protection; a later return formula closes the surah's argument. The focus return is thus rehearsed in present action before it is completed as universal destination.

activation_trace.role: Return to a source anchors both the present transfer and the final destination.
Handing an affair to another in reliance turns return into an immediate allocation of agency.
Actual protection supplies a this-world consequence of that transfer.
The later return echo restores the universal and terminal horizon.

structural_cues: 40:44-45 immediately enact reliance and protection after the focus claim, while 40:77 repeats return to the divine speaker near the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, immediate delegation, ensuing protection, and a later return echo; I infer a present-to-final continuum of agency. A live alternative is that the focus return is strictly eschatological and the adjacent rescue is only narrative confirmation.

changed_reading.before: Our return to God names only a postmortem destination.
changed_reading.after: Return begins now as surrender of the affair to God, proves effective in present protection, and culminates in the unavoidable final return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Chosen relations of following and invocation fail under pressure: leaders cannot relieve followers, and called objects disappear. The focus companionship then becomes a reversal in which the relation people selected does not endure, while fire becomes their permanent associate and lodging.

activation_trace.role: Accompaniment anchors the final durable relationship.
Following behind leaders supplies a chosen social attachment that later proves unable to save.
The retrospective invocation identifies the failed relation as the same call network denied in the focus.
Loss of the called objects supplies their disappearance precisely when companionship would be needed.
Clinging permanence gives the replacement association its duration.
Settled residence turns companionship with fire into a domicile rather than a passing encounter.

structural_cues: 40:47 has followers seek relief from leaders; 40:74 has former objects disappear and callers deny the prior relation; 40:76 supplies permanent lodging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed following, vanished objects, and permanent lodging; I infer a replacement relation in which fire occupies the companionship that chosen patrons cannot sustain. A live alternative is that أصحاب remains only a conventional group label.

changed_reading.before: The transgressors belong to the category of people punished by fire.
changed_reading.after: The relations they choose cannot accompany or rescue them; their only durable companionship is the fire that replaces those vanished attachments.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later scenes unpack companionship with fire as a process: repeated exposure, bodily binding, linked restraint, forced transport, and active stoking. The social relation in the focus acquires temporal, mechanical, and material dimensions.

activation_trace.role: Sustained accompaniment is the focus relation that the later sequence materializes.
The same kindled fire becomes the repeatedly encountered object.
Being brought out for viewing supplies scheduled exposure rather than a single event.
A collar binding the body turns association into imposed attachment.
Connected links supply the continuity and articulated mechanics of restraint.
Dragging and extension convert attachment into forced movement toward the fire.
Active ignition makes the companion an intensified material environment.

structural_cues: 40:46 supplies morning-and-evening exposure, 40:71-72 supplies binding, dragging, and stoking, and 40:76 supplies residence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separate stages of exposure, restraint, transport, and ignition; I infer that the sequence narratively unpacks companionship. I do not infer an etymological identity between ص ح ب and س ح ب; a live alternative is that these are only later punishment details.

changed_reading.before: Companions of fire is a static designation.
changed_reading.after: Companionship is an imposed process and environment: repeated exposure becomes bodily attachment, transport, and residence within an actively maintained fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated label is paired with lying and destabilizing doubt, then embedded in argument without warrant and pride. Near the end, joy exceeds measure and people exult in their own knowledge. Israf here becomes epistemic and social overreach: confidence, claim, and recruitment extend beyond supplied authority.

activation_trace.role: Boundary transgression anchors the category whose operative boundary the context specifies.
The repeated boundary-crossing label carries the focus category into an epistemic setting.
Unsettled doubt supplies one form of the excess: destabilization persists despite prior signs.
A compelling warrant supplies the missing limit that their argument exceeds.
Joy explicitly exceeding its proper measure gives affective form to boundary overrun.
Exultant self-satisfaction supplies the posture that seals the group inside its own assessment.
Knowledge as disclosure becomes enclosed as a possession in which they exult rather than a sign that corrects them.

structural_cues: 40:28 pairs the repeated label with lying, 40:34 pairs it with doubt, 40:35 describes argument without warrant and a proud heart, and 40:75 plus 40:83 expose excessive joy in self-held knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated pairings with lying, doubt, unsupported argument, pride, and measure-exceeding joy; I infer that these specify the relevant boundary as epistemic and social. A live alternative is the broader sense of generic transgression.

changed_reading.before: The musrifin are generic sinners or people excessive in expenditure.
changed_reading.after: They are people whose claims, confidence, and recruitment outrun warrant, turning uncertainty and self-satisfied knowledge into a socially coercive overreach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because جَرَمَ in the formula can function as conventional emphasis, so the acquisition branch may not control its syntax. It remains anchored in a supplied focus branch and in the surah's repeated earning-and-recompense sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a causal undertone, not as the primary translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2, جَرَمَ, can activate acquisition and causing alongside severance.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring or causing supplies an undertone that the announced liability has been brought about by the actors.
Recompense matching action supplies the consequence side of the acquisition mechanism.
Earning and obtaining supply the actor-side causal input.
The final failure of accumulated gains prevents earned power from averting the verdict.

changed_reading.after: Beneath the certainty formula is a possible accounting claim: their overrun has caused or acquired the fire-companionship now pronounced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because a residual-milk image is not the ordinary sense of دعوة in the verse. It remains worth carrying because the same focus root supplies that generative image and the context explicitly contrasts collapsing repeated appeal with an answered call; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for response propagation, never a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The noun دعوة at word 8 can be tested against the branch image of a remainder that elicits what follows.

activation_trace.role: A retained remainder that draws forth the next yield supplies a generative-seed analogy for an effective call.
Successive falling supplies the counter-image of an appeal chain collapsing instead of propagating.
An actual answer supplies the continuation that distinguishes the valid call relation.

changed_reading.before: The rival has no valid prayer or claim.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the rival has no generative remainder that can draw forth an answer: its call chain cannot reproduce or continue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface denotes fire, while the shared root inventory also carries illumination. It remains anchored by that supplied root and by the later sequence of exposure and sight; downstream prose should qualify illumination as a secondary irony of the fire, not replace its punitive sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 22, ٱلنَّارِ, shares an inventory in which kindled fire and illumination coexist.

activation_trace.role: Kindled fire preserves the direct punitive anchor.
Illumination supplies a secondary function in which the fire makes denied reality visible.
Repeated presentation for viewing turns the fire into an unavoidable display.
Direct sight supplies the belated recognition produced when punishment is finally encountered.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only the place or instrument of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Fire also becomes, secondarily and too late, the illuminating display that forces recognition; they accompany the evidence they had refused.

strongest_changes: دعوة became a test of reciprocal response, adjudicative standing, and effective relational access rather than mere vocal invocation.
مَرَدَّنَا became a present transfer of agency enacted in 40:44-45 as well as the final destination echoed in 40:77.
أَصْحَابُ ٱلنَّارِ became the durable replacement for failed chosen attachments and was materially unpacked as exposure, binding, transport, ignition, and residence.
ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ became an epistemic-social category whose claims and confidence exceed warrant, not merely a generic label for excess.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a repeated call-and-answer architecture, failed delegation of appeal, disappearance of called objects, and a shift from chosen following to forced residence. These sequences made the social mechanics of 40:43 more salient than a generic polemic against false objects.
remaining_uncertainties: دعوة may foreground claim, capacity to call, accepted invocation, or all three without requiring a single disambiguation.
لَا جَرَمَ may remain conventional emphasis even though cutting and acquisition branches produce coherent secondary readings.
The material unpacking of companionship may be narrative elaboration rather than semantic content carried directly by أَصْحَاب.
